propositions: A ticket with a live supersedes or duplicates link cannot be closed via administrative disposition without --force because the plan-review close gate lacks visibility into the close class and evidence.
The plan-review close gate function signature omits close_class and tracker parameters, preventing it from evaluating link-backed evidence that the completion verification gate already reuses.
Superseded tickets by construction cannot earn a plan-review attestation because reviewer findings correctly block on already-completed work, creating an unsatisfiable verification requirement.

The obligation to support administrative disposition closes was introduced in commit fc20-2df1-426e-42ab when ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES were extended to task/story/epic, but the plan-review gate was not updated in parallel with the completion gate.

Force-closing a legitimately superseded ticket with no alternative path degrades the audit trail of its entire ancestor epic chain, stripping completion signatures from tickets that had legitimate evidence.
